title: Inpaint Biases: A Pathway to Accurate and Unbiased Image Generation

bias_targets.target: Concept representation bias (Bias against unconventional concepts)
bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models with unusual or unconventional object-attribute combinations (e.g., blue bananas, chocolate rivers, polka-dotted cats) and quantitatively evaluating the alignment between the textual prompt and the generated images using CLIP scores.

primary_bias_target: Concept representation bias (Bias against unconventional concepts)
